datasets.title: Geodata of Flood Waters and Inundation Near Khwaja Du Koh, Jawzjan Province, Afghanistan
datasets.description: This map illustrates satellite-detected water bodies and inundated areas near Khwajah Du Koh, Jawzjan Province, Afghanistan as seen on WorldView-2 satellite imagery collected 29 April 2014. Heavy rainfall occurred on 23-24 April 2014, flooding a large part of the town. UNOSAT extracted a Water Index from the satellite image to determine areas of standing water as well as soils with varying levels of water content (ie, mud). It is likely that flood waters and inundation have been systematically underestimated along highly vegetated areas and within built-up urban areas because of the special characteristics of the satellite data used. This analysis has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR /UNOSAT.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-flood-waters-and-inundation-near-khwaja-du-koh-jawzjan-province-af-may-01-2014]
datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics of the source imagery used in the analyses when interpreting results. For damage assessments it should be noted that only significant damage to the structural integrity of the buildings analyzed can be seen in imagery, while minor damage such as cracks or holes may not be visible at all. For flood extractions using radar data it is important to note that urban areas and highly vegetated areas may mask the flood signature and result in underestimation of flood waters. Users with specific questions or concerns should contact unosat@unitar.org to seek clarification.

lineage.description: UNOSAT analysts extracted a Water Index from WorldView-2 satellite imagery acquired on 29 April 2014 to detect standing water and saturated soils following heavy rainfall on 23-24 April 2014. The resulting water body and inundation extent polygons were validated and compiled into shapefiles representing the observed flood hazard footprint.

sources.name: United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT)
sources.description: Satellite imagery analysis using WorldView-2 data and Water Index extraction methodology to delineate standing water bodies and inundated areas with varying soil moisture content
